data.short_description: Tifa Chocolate & Gelato is a franchise dessert concept offering handcrafted gelato, artisan chocolates, and specialty desserts. A new location is planned at 508 E. San Gabriel Parkway, Suite 150, at Northline in Leander, with construction scheduled to wrap up in December 2026. An official opening date has not yet been announced.

data.status: set to arrive in North Charleston this summer
data.short_description: Next Round Social is an entertainment venue featuring tech-infused mini golf, axe throwing, duckpin bowling, an arcade, and a full-service restaurant and bar. The venue is set to open at 4391 Dorchester Rd. in North Charleston this summer, co-owned by Erica Garriss and her husband. The concept is inspired by 1980s and 1990s South Beach Miami vibes and aims to serve as a destination for bachelor and bachelorette parties and corporate gatherings.

data.location: 500 Inland Center Dr, San Bernardino, CA 92408
data.short_description: Candeeland Wonderpark is a candy-themed indoor family entertainment concept featuring multi-level play structures, slides, tunnels, arcade games, and private party rooms. A new location is expected to open at 500 Inland Center Drive in San Bernardino in December 2026, as revealed by owner Peter Cho. The venue is designed as a large-scale indoor playground for children with an emphasis on active play, imagination, and group celebrations.

data.status: An opening date has not yet been announced
data.short_description: Chloe is a new modern American comfort food restaurant concept from local restaurateur Sean Rouzbeh, planned for 1 S Wacker Drive in downtown Chicago. An opening date has not yet been announced and the team describes it as early in the opening process. The space will feature an outdoor patio on the first floor and is named in memory of the owner's family dog.

data.status: permit application describes an "existing business expanding into adjacent space"
data.short_description: Frank's Beer Shop is a neighborhood beer destination in Charlotte preparing to expand into adjacent space at 3348 Commonwealth Avenue as a Bar/Coffee Shop. A permit application was filed describing the expansion, which aligns with owner Joe Smaldone's previously stated plans for a partnership with Enderly Coffee and longer operating hours. No timeline, opening date, or menu details have been announced.

data.location: 1223 W 34th St, Suite C-200, Houston, TX 77018
data.short_description: The Pho Fix is a Vietnamese restaurant known for pho and vermicelli bowls that operated at The Stomping Grounds in Garden Oaks, Houston. The restaurant closed its doors on Monday, June 8, with the team citing "after much thought and consideration, we have made the difficult decision to close The Pho Fix." No reason was given for the closure in the announcement.

Clouds Brewing is a Raleigh-based craft beer brand that serves house-brewed beer and elevated pub fare. The brewery plans to open a new location at 505 W. Jones Street in downtown Raleigh, in the space formerly occupied by Tobacco Road Sports Cafe, with an opening expected in early July. The brewery announced it acquired the assets and operations of the property effective June 1, and current employees will remain with the business.

Palermo Argentinian Bistro is an Argentine steakhouse concept offering wood-fired grilled meats, fresh seafood, house-made breads, and Argentine wines. The restaurant's third Manhattan location will open on June 11 at 55 Grand Street in SoHo, owned by founder Orhan Cakir, executive chef Carlos Barroz, and wine director Jorge Albarracin. The opening coincides with the start of the FIFA World Cup, and the venue plans to show tournament matches throughout the bar area and on a projector screen.

data.status: An opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: Ross Tavern is a corner bar-restaurant offering contemporary American fare including bar snacks, chicken wings, soups, salads, and handhelds, planning to open at 1665 Madison Ave in East Harlem. An opening date has not been announced and What Now New York has reached out for more information. The venue will be located in a former deli, serve food until 11 p.m., remain open until 4 a.m. daily, and seat 40 guests with a maximum capacity of 74.

Alla Vita is an Italian restaurant from Boka Restaurant Group focusing on handmade pastas, wood-fired pizza, wines, and cocktails. The restaurant will open on June 13, 2026, at 523 Houston Street in Nashville's Wedgewood Houston neighborhood, representing the third concept from Boka Restaurant Group in that area. The restaurant is helmed by award-winning Chef Lee Wolen of Michelin-starred Boka and occupies space within the 18-acre Wedgewood Village mixed-use development.

Habibi Supper Club is a Lebanese restaurant concept from former accountant turned restaurateur Miled Finianos, planning to open its first brick-and-mortar location at 1515 Passyunk Ave. in Philadelphia's East Passyunk neighborhood this fall. The restaurant will serve breakfast and lunch before transitioning into a supper club on weekend evenings with a monthly rotating prix fixe menu. The concept grew out of a private supper club that expanded from intimate dinner parties to events of over 30 guests.

data.status: opened a new shop in Pearland on June 8
data.short_description: Graze Craze is a fast-growing charcuterie chain offering handcrafted charcuterie boards, picnic boxes, and catering for corporate events, gifting, and everyday occasions. The brand opened a new 1,440-square-foot shop at 1901 Kirby Drive, Suite 102, in Shadow Creek Center in Pearland on June 8, 2026. The location is owned by sisters Marisol de la Fuente and Marlen Gonzalez, who will also conduct charcuterie workshops and wine-pairing events.

data.status: should be open before the end of summer
data.short_description: Einstein Bros Bagels is a national bagel chain offering fresh-baked bagels and cream cheese spreads, planning a new location in Spring, Texas. Construction is currently underway at the H-E-B Gosling Market shopping center at 5330 FM 2920 Rd, with the project estimated at $350,000 and slated to wrap up towards the end of July. The brand operates more than 700 locations across the country and is part of Bagel Brands.

data.location: 2414 W University Dr, Suite 118, McKinney, TX 75071
data.status: aims to open in early to mid-August
data.short_description: Gravy & More is a breakfast-and-brunch comfort food restaurant operating as a scratch kitchen, offering biscuits and gravy, chicken and waffles, omelets, pancakes, burgers, and homestyle entrées. The restaurant is planning a new location at 2414 W. University Drive, Suite 118, in the 380 Marketplace retail center in McKinney, aiming to open in early to mid-August pending permits. The concept is led by siblings Michelle Bezanilla and Phil Hughes and will be approximately 3,000 square feet, becoming the brand's second location after its Red Oak restaurant.

Hearsay is a nostalgic cocktail bar with an '80s and '90s retro vibe offering a juice-driven cocktail program paired with a Korean-inspired menu. The bar is set to open at 1222 Walnut St. in Philadelphia this summer, targeting a late June debut, from hospitality veteran Justin Jordan of Home Hospitality Group. The four-story building also houses three other Home Hospitality Group concepts: Celine, HYO, and Chancellor Room.

HYO is a classic Korean tabletop barbecue concept from Home Hospitality Group that will open later this summer at 1222 Walnut St. in Philadelphia. Guests will enter through a phone booth, located behind Hearsay at the same address. The concept is one of four hospitality ventures by Justin Jordan's Home Hospitality Group in the same four-story building.

Chancellor Room is a dimly lit cocktail space described as "where ambiance leads the experience," set to debut this fall on the second floor of 1222 Walnut St. in Philadelphia. The concept is one of four from Home Hospitality Group's Justin Jordan opening in the same building. No further details have been announced.

data.location: 7001 Orchard Lake Rd, West Bloomfield Township, MI 48322
data.status: an opening date hasn't been announced
data.short_description: Pure Green is a national juice bar chain with over 100 locations offering cold-pressed juices, smoothies, toast, and oatmeal bowls. A new location is coming to The Boardwalk Shopping Center at 700 Orchard Lake Road in West Bloomfield, debuted by local franchisee George Taylor, though an opening date has not been announced. The space was recently secured and Pure Green will join the plaza alongside Dairy Queen, New York Bagel, Nothing Bundt Cakes, and Stage Deli Restaurant.

data.location: 714 Washington Blvd, Marina Del Rey, CA 90292
data.short_description: Niche Cafe is a Los Angeles coffee and smoothie concept that launched in 2018 as a trailer operating along Abbott Kinney Boulevard. The cafe is planning to open a brick-and-mortar location at 714 Washington Blvd in Marina Del Rey this summer, though the team does not have an exact opening date. The menu features coffee, matcha, specialty smoothies, and milkshakes.

data.status: aiming for an August opening date
data.short_description: The Carlyle Club is a new dining concept from owner Steve Gogolab coming to 316 N Clark Street in Chicago's riverfront area this summer, featuring a 72-seat patio and a menu of sandwiches, seafood, and steaks with international flavors. Owner Steve Gogolab is aiming for an August opening date and is working with Deliz partner and chef Jakob Peterson on the project. The address was previously occupied by The Kitchen American Bistro, which closed earlier this year.

The Kitchen American Bistro was a restaurant located at 316 N Clark Street in Chicago. It closed earlier this year and the space is now being prepared for The Carlyle Club. The closure detail appears within the Carlyle Club opening article.

data.status: an exact opening timeline has not been finalized yet
data.short_description: High Noon Brunchery is a Southern-inspired breakfast restaurant known as Georgia's first all-pink café, planning to relocate from its Douglasville flagship to a 4,000-square-foot space at 2285 Peachtree Road in Buckhead. The space was formerly home to Another Broken Egg Café, and an exact opening timeline has not been finalized yet. The relocation was triggered by lease negotiation challenges at the original Douglasville location.

data.status: lease negotiation challenges at their original Douglasville location
data.short_description: High Noon Brunchery is a Southern-inspired breakfast restaurant that launched in 2024 as Georgia's first all-pink café. The original Douglasville flagship is closing due to lease negotiation challenges, with the brand relocating to Buckhead. Co-founder Porche Perryman stated "We're not closing — we're growing," framing the closure as a relocation rather than an end of business.

data.status: targeting an opening ahead of the upcoming college football season
data.short_description: Atomic Wings is a Buffalo-inspired chicken wing chain serving wings, tenders, sandwiches, and sauces. The franchise owner confirmed the restaurant is targeting an opening before the college football season begins at 2112 N. High St. in Columbus, Ohio. The project is currently in the design and planning stages, and will feature 100% halal, never-frozen chicken paired with approximately 15 sauces.

data.status: aiming for a July opening date
data.short_description: Osteria Gilberto is an upcoming Italian restaurant concept from owner Sergio Barbone. A liquor license application was recently submitted for the location at 1224 W Webster Avenue in Lincoln Park, with Barbone aiming for a July opening. Barbone also owns Bakehouse Chicago, with locations in Lakeview, Roscoe Village, and Southport.

Le Petit Comptoir Wine & Cheese is an upcoming wine-and-cheese concept from owner Alex Lewis, focused on small plates, charcuterie, and zero-proof options alongside wine. The business is tentatively targeting a July 2026 opening beside Marblehead House of Pizza at 1 Atlantic Ave in Marblehead, with hiring currently underway. Lewis has been building early momentum through weekly wine-and-cheese tastings and pairing events ahead of the grand opening.

The Laureate is a new boutique hotel being developed by Tina McCarthy in partnership with Chad Ingram and Rob Johnston, incorporating the historic Farmers and Merchants Bank Building at 167 Laurens St. along with adjacent property on Park Ave. The project will break ground this fall in downtown Aiken, featuring a four-story structure with 84 rooms, suites, and extended-stay residences, as well as a lobby bar and garden courtyard. The historic renovation will house a restaurant and bar, meeting rooms, fitness space, and possibly a small spa, with the restaurant still finalizing its menu and name.
